items.title: Resolution No. 2026-036 - A Resolution Adopting The Town Of Alpine 2026 Master Plan As Adopted And Certified By The Town Of Alpine Planning And Zoning Commission; Repealing Resolution No. 2025-014; And Reinstating Section 1-104(B)(7) Of The Town Of Alpine Land Use And Development Code:
items.description: Suggested Motion: Motion to approve Resolution No. 2026-036, adopting the Town of Alpine 2026 Master Plan as adopted and certified by the Town of Alpine Planning and Zoning Commission, repealing Resolution No. 2025-014, and reinstating Section 1-104(B)(7) of the Town of Alpine Land Use and Development Code.

items.title: Authorization to Submit an Out-of-Cycle Travel & Tourism Grant Application for the 2027 Music in the Mountains Series - Up to $32,000 from FY27 and FY28 Funds:
items.description: Suggested Motion: Motion to authorize staff to submit an out-of-cycle application to the Town of Alpine Travel and Tourism Board for the 2027 Music in the Mountains series in an amount up to $32,000, including a request for approval of $8,000 from FY27 Travel and Tourism funds for the June band bookings, and $24,000 for FY28 Travel & Tourism funds for the July through September bookings subject to available funding and grant approval.

attachments.name: 2026.09.28 Events Committee Staff Report Music in the Mountains Summer 2027 Series Out-of-Cycle Grant Request.pdf

items.title: Approval of an Additional $3,500 in FY27 Expenses for the 2027 Music in the Mountains Summer Series, Increasing the Authorized Amount to $23,500, with the Increase Funded from Prior-Year Fund Balance:
items.description: Suggested Motion: Motion to approve an additional $3,500 in FY27 expenses for the Music in the Mountains 2027 Summer Series, increasing the total authorized amount from $20,000 to $23,500, and to fund the $3,500 increase from the prior-year fund balance

attachments.name: 2023.09.28 Events Committee Staff Report Music in the Mountains increase in expenses.pdf

items.title: Used Service Pickup with Crane:
items.description: Suggested Motion: Motion to authorize staff to purchase a used service pickup, equipped with a crane, in an amount not to exceed $75,000 and direct staff to amend the water fund capital outlays budget by $30,000 to accommodate this purchase.
